role: The client's entity render dispatch: a class-to-Render map built once, renderEntityWithPosYaw's interpolation and camera translation, the distance cull, and the camera/view state (playerViewY/X, viewerPos) every billboard renderer reads.

notes: draw_hitboxes is the play-path dispatcher (misleadingly named; it draws every entity). raster_mobs_scene is the recorded-scene equivalent used by test_render. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): frame-state plumbing replaced by the native frame path; debug boxes are off. Formerly listed as missing: func_147938_a/func_147937_a/func_147940_a: the frame-state plumbing and the alternate render entry points have no native counterpart; the native frame path replaces them. Name-tag rendering (fontRenderer, func_85094_b's path), the debug bounding box, and the RenderManager singleton have no native counterpart.
